final: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), rates AS (SELECT *, AVG(rate) OVER () AS mean_rate FROM album_stats) SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate, AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(rate - mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM rates WHERE rate > mean_rate
